variants.name: God Monument
variants.notes: One is built per god; footprint and role are identical every time.

variants.name: Common Agora
variants.notes: Rotates to 6x3 the other way round.

variants.name: Grand Agora
variants.notes: Rotates to 6x5 the other way round.

variants.name: Stadium
variants.notes: Rotates to 10x5 the other way round.

variants.name: Palace
variants.notes: Rotates to 8x4 the other way round.

variants.name: Gatehouse
variants.notes: Rotates to 5x2 the other way round.

variants.name: Horse Ranch Enclosure
variants.notes: An unstaffed paddock attached to a Horse Ranch, not an independent building.

variants.name: Trireme Wharf
variants.notes: A full 100-strong rowing crew, not shipyard labour.

variants.name: Major Shrine
variants.notes: One is built per god (fourteen in total) - a Shrine fully exalted to its final tier.

variants.name: Minor Shrine
variants.notes: One is built per god (fourteen in total) - the first tier of a sanctuary.

variants.name: Shrine
variants.notes: One is built per god (fourteen in total) - a Minor Shrine grown to its second tier.
